name: Merantix Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Merantix Capital (merantix-capital.com), which its About page calls a Berlin-based venture capital firm and a unit of Merantix, a group of AI companies and initiatives. The imprint names Merantix Fund Management GmbH, Max-Urich-Str. 3, AI Campus, 13355 Berlin (HRB 254046 B, Amtsgericht Berlin-Charlottenburg); managing directors Adrian Locher, Dr. Rasmus Rothe and Janette Wiget. The SFDR page names Merantix Fund Management GmbH as AIFM of Merantix AI Fund GmbH & Co. KG and also names MX Fund II GmbH & Co. KG. The parent group, Merantix AG (merantix.com), links its 'Investments' arm to merantix-capital.com; the group's other units are Merantix Momentum (AI solutions/services provider), the Merantix AI Campus (Berlin co-working and community), AI House Davos and the London AI Hub. Those are not investors and are not recorded here. Merantix Capital itself runs two things: a Venture Studio (pre-idea incubation of companies built with founders-in-residence on the AI Campus) and, since the €103M Merantix AI Fund (closed June 2026), direct pre-seed and seed investing. Studio companies are recorded as rounds only where a page says Merantix / Merantix Capital invested in that round. Press often writes just 'Merantix' for the investor (e.g. Tech.eu on WhyBrilliant, Briink, Ovom Care; Silicon Canals on Deltia); since the group's investing arm is Merantix Capital, 'Merantix' is kept as an alias. The LinkedIn page linked from merantix-capital.com is the group page (linkedin.com/company/merantix). Not Merantix Momentum, not Merantix Healthcare, and not unrelated firms with similar names.

open_items: First fund: Handelsblatt says about €30M, all invested in pre-incorporation studio companies; no vehicle name, vintage or close date found. Silicon Canals (2024) says Merantix had 'raised over €30M to date'.
MX Fund II GmbH & Co. KG appears only on the SFDR page; size, vintage and whether it is the ~€30M first fund are unknown. No MX Fund I was found.

Merantix AI Fund: €103M final close announced 4 Jun 2026; plans about 40 investments (Tech.eu), split 50/50 between venture-studio companies and direct pre-seed/seed deals. LPs named: Union Investment, Jungheinrich, KPMG Germany, Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, W.K. Kellogg Foundation. The fund was already deploying in 2025 (Droidrun, Arqh).

Handelsblatt (Jun 2026) says Merantix Capital invested only in its own studio companies for ten years and the new fund is its first for direct investments, yet press names Merantix in outside rounds (Briink 2024, Ovom Care 2024) — those companies are also listed on the portfolio page as 'Pre-Idea' studio companies, so they are likely follow-ons in studio companies.

No application form, pitch email or submission route was found on merantix-capital.com (the 'Get started' button points to an on-page anchor). accepts_cold_inbound left unknown. Nothing found on requiring a US entity or on Indian founders, so the latter is omitted.

No portfolio count is stated. The portfolio page lists 24 entries, including 5 stealth ventures and 3 exits (Libra/libratech acquired by Wolters Kluwer, Kausa by SAP, Clemens Viernickel's company acquired by Scale AI).

Partners not recorded: Matthieu Dederichs (Venture Partner; software, AI/ML, fintech, health tech, consumer), Matilda Glynn-Henley and Laetizia Hellmeister (both 'Investor', no focus stated), Pranav Tadikonda (Investment Team). Janette Wiget is a managing director in the imprint but not on the team page. Oliver Schmied is CFO.

Rounds not recorded: Graph Therapeutics' pre-seed (build page says Merantix Capital co-led a pre-seed extended to $3.1M; no dated press page found) and its Jun 2026 $5M round led by Daphni (Tech.eu names Merantix Capital only as an existing investor); revel8's earlier pre-seed (build page says Merantix-led, undated); Vara's $8.9M (Oct 2024, Merantix not named); METEORIC, Hoshii, Cambrium, Deltia later rounds — no round page found naming Merantix.
Outpost Bio and Ovom Care HQ country and founding year, and Droidrun/Arqh/Briink/WhyBrilliant founding years, are not on the fetched pages.
LinkedIn: the only LinkedIn link on merantix-capital.com is the Merantix group page; no separate Merantix Capital company page was verified (LinkedIn is login-walled).
The user list's 'AI' and '2026 fund EUR 103M' leads are confirmed by the firm's own fund post and Tech.eu, Handelsblatt, Pulse 2.0 and Gründerszene.
